text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Right! For example, for the bouquet, I'd 
love to know what your absolute favorite 
color scheme is!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Yellow?!?!?!?!? It's... it's not cherry 
blossom pink—?!?!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is the meaning of this!? The 
strongest color for me should be the 
strongest for everyone else too...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but... Flower-san. You're fond of 
cherry blossom pink too, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, of course! It's lovely, 
dignified—and besides, it's Bakushin 
O-san's color, too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, like a fragrant storm of blossoms... 
I too feel it is a powerful color that 
gives you a gentle push forward.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes, totally...! They're so cute, yet so 
strong. Watching them gives me so much 
energy and courage!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufun!! But of course!! Cherry blossom 
pink is truly the absolute strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, preparati—*Ahem!* As the class 
representative, I shall work even 
haaaarder to fulfill my duties!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... The shimmering spring breeze, 
indeed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder what kind of bouquet it'll be... 
I'm sure it's packed full of energy and 
courage.)
